description: We are a team passionate about space, technology, and problem-solving. By combining coding, data analysis, and design, we build creative, data-driven solutions using NASA’s open data while learning and having fun along the way.
summary:
ANDROMEDA-X is a browser-based explorer that makes NASA's SPHEREx all-sky infrared survey accessible to everyone. SPHEREx maps the whole sky in 102 spectral channels (0.75–5.0 µm), but its data comes as large, complex FITS files. Because each detector uses a linear variable filter, wavelength changes across every image, which makes the data hard to use without specialist tools
Our platform lets users search by coordinates or object name. They can view data by band, channels or false-colour RGB, and click any pixel to extract over time with blink and diffrence maps, scan images for anomalies, and keep an exportable observation notebook. A pyhton/FastAPI backend fetches live data from NASA/IPAC IRSA and streams it as 256×256 tiles. The tiles use lossless compression (delta encoding + byte-shuffle + Zstandard), and compression is measured in real time. This matters because it turns a professional dataset into something students, educators and citizen scientists can explore and learn from. It keeps the science honest: raw data is never modified and simulated content is always labelled. It is also accesible, with colour-blind-safe maps, sonification and a bilingual İnterface.
details: Andromeda-X is a web-based explorer for NASA's SPHEREx infrared all-sky survey (102 channels, 0.75–5.0 µm). Users search by coordinates or object name, view the data by band, channel or RGB composite, and click any pixel to get its spectrum. They can also compare observations over time, scan for anomalies and save notes. It turns comples FITS data into something students, teachers and citizen scientists can explore in a browser, with no installation needed. We used Python, FastAPI, Astroquery, NumPy, Zstandart, HTML/CSS/javaScript, Canvas and Web workers, Data comes from NASA/IPAC IRSA. AI assistance (Claude) supported coding and writing. Our project is creative because it has one-click spectra, sonification (hear a spectrum as sound), a guided sky tour and live compression telemetry. We considered Scientific accuracy (raw data is never modified), clear labelling of demo content, accessibility (colour-blind-safe maps, Turkish/English interface), privacy (uploaded files stay in the browser) and performance (tiling and lossless compression).
